pages.phone: Tab bar scrolls horizontally; settings aside stacks below the element list.
uxNotes: Uses an in-page tab bar (layout NavLinks) for Aufbau/Einsendungen; the design guide says sub-pages go into the sidebar tree, not a tab bar.
Trash is a plain outline button at the page bottom without confirm, not a red ⋯ item (guide: delete = destructive ⋯ item with confirm).
Removing an element has no confirm.
Every element has its own 'Speichern' button plus the settings SaveBar: many save points, and no live preview of the public form.
Reordering is one server round-trip per step (↑/↓), no drag.
Public link only appears when published; no copy button, and the slug field shows no full URL.
Text elements and consent are plain textareas, not the RichTextEditor used in email.

redesign.job: Build the form (fields, texts, consents) and its settings, then publish it.

Element rows full width (kind, name, ↑ ↓ ✕, inputs), '+ Element hinzufügen' (action sheet), then the settings card, SaveBar at the bottom.
redesign.desktop: Header with 'Veröffentlichen' as primary for drafts (saves + publishes). Segments under the header. RecordLayout: elements left, Einstellungen right; one form, one SaveBar.

pages.title: Formular (title) › Einsendungen
pages.purpose: Review submissions; accept (creates member) or reject membership applications.

header.notes: same layout header + tab bar as /forms/[id]

overlays.title: <person name>
overlays.notes: Status badge, buttons 'Zum Kontakt' (/contacts/<id>) and 'Zur Mitgliedschaft' (/members/<id>) when linked, DetailList of contact data, custom values (raw keys), membership type, desired start, IBAN, account holder, consents (✓/✗).

uxNotes: Default filter is 'Alle' although the forms list advertises 'Neue Einsendungen' counts; new ones are not pre-filtered.
Accept/Reject (creates a membership or rejects an applicant) have no confirmation; buttons are plain side by side, main action not at the thumb on phones.
Custom field values in the sheet are labelled by their raw key, not the field label.
Status filter is a hand-built chip nav; export uses <ExportMenu> in the toolbar while other lists put export in the header ⋯.

redesign.job: Work through new submissions: read one, accept or reject it.
redesign.phone: Same header + Segments. Toolbar: Segments Neu · Angenommen · Abgelehnt · Alle. Cards: person + status badge, email, date. Sheet: badge, Verknüpft rows (Kontakt, Mitgliedschaft), DetailList of answers by label, buttons stacked full width at the bottom (Annehmen at the thumb).
redesign.desktop: Toolbar Segments; table Person, E-Mail, Eingegangen, Status; sheet with actions in the title row.

research: Tally / Typeform / Fillout: the builder is one canvas of blocks you edit in place, add with '+' (or '/'), reorder and delete per block (asks first when it has answers); publish is the main button; Results/Submissions is a tab with 'new' marked; one submission opens in a side panel with every answer by its label. Taken: Aufbau · Einsendungen as record Segments, elements as inline rows saved with one SaveBar, '+ Element' menu, 'Veröffentlichen' as the primary of a draft, submissions open on 'Neu'.
